title: Lilo and Stitch.
lines: On a sunny island in Hawaii lives a girl called Lilo.
She is six years old.
She lives with her big sister Nani in a little house by the beach.
Lilo loves surfing, feeding fish and strange songs.
But Lilo sometimes feels alone.
The other girls don't want to play with her.
They think she's a bit strange.
Far, far away, in space, lives a little blue creature.
He has big ears, black eyes and four little arms.
He's called Experiment 626.
He was made by a crazy professor.
He is very strong and very fast, and a bit naughty.
He bites everything and he breaks everything.
One day he escapes in a little spaceship.
Whoooosh!
He flies through the stars and crashes on Earth.
Right on Lilo's island.
Lilo really wants a puppy.
Nani takes her to the animal shelter.
And there, among the dogs, sits the little blue creature.
He's pretending to be a dog.
Woof, he says.
Lilo looks at him and smiles.
I want that one!
Lilo calls him Stitch.
Stitch lives with Lilo and Nani now.
But he isn't like an ordinary dog.
He builds a city out of biscuits and throws them around.
He eats a whole coffee cup.
He plays the guitar, really loudly.
He makes a hole in the wall.
Nani gets angry.
Lilo, that dog has to go!
But Lilo wants to keep Stitch.
He's my friend, she says.
She teaches Stitch things.
She teaches him to be nice.
She teaches him to surf the waves.
She teaches him to dance.
And she tells him about a word from Hawaii.
Ohana.
Ohana means family, says Lilo.
And family means nobody gets left behind.
Or forgotten.
Stitch looks at Lilo.
Ohana, he says softly.
He has never had a family before.
But the crazy professor is looking for Stitch.
He comes to Earth in a big spaceship.
One evening he takes Stitch away.
And Lilo too!
The spaceship flies up into the sky.
Nani screams.
Lilo!
Stitch manages to escape.
He sees the spaceship with Lilo inside.
And he knows.
Ohana means nobody gets left behind.
Stitch jumps into another spaceship.
He flies after it.
He's so fast.
He jumps onto the big ship.
He climbs inside.
And he sets Lilo free!
Together they fly back to the beach.
Nani runs up to them and hugs Lilo really tight.
Then the big boss of space arrives.
A woman with a long neck.
She says: This creature must come with us.
It is a dangerous experiment.
But Lilo holds on to Stitch.
He isn't dangerous.
He's my family.
I adopted him.
Look, I have a paper that says so.
The big boss reads the paper.
She looks at Stitch.
Stitch looks back very sweetly.
She smiles.
All right, she says.
Then he may stay.
But you must look after him well.
And so Stitch stays on the island.
With Lilo and Nani.
He still breaks things sometimes.
But he learns a little more every day.
And every evening the three of them sit on the beach and watch the sunset.
Lilo, Nani and Stitch.
A small family, but a good one.
Ohana.
The end.
